(formerly [[Rustboro City]]) |relatives=Raizoh Cozmo (father), unnamed mother |region=[[Hoenn]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass=[[Pokémon Professor]] |game=yes |generation={{Gen|III}}, {{Gen|VI}} |games={{game3|Ruby and Sapphire|Ruby, Sapphire|s}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, Alpha Sapphire}} |leader=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG054 |epname=Fight for the Meteorite! |enva=[[Sean Schemmel]] |java=Tomohiro Nishimura |gameanim=yes |pv=yes |pvnum=PG09 |pvname=The Scoop |envagame=Unknown |javagame=[[Nobuo Tobita]] }} '''Professor Takao Cozmo''' (Japanese: '''ソライシ・タカオ博士''' ''Dr. Takao Soraishi'') is a character in {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s|Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire}}. He is a meteoriticist who lives in [[Fallarbor Town]]. ==In the games== [[File:Professor Cozmo ORAS.png|thumb|left|200px|Professor Cozmo at his home in Fallarbor Town]] Professor Cozmo leaves either with [[Team Magma]]{{sup/3|R}}{{sup/3|E}}{{sup/6|OR}} or [[Team Aqua]]{{sup/3|S}}{{sup/6|AS}} for the [[Meteor Falls]], thinking that they are going to help him excavate meteors. However, the offending team steals the [[Meteorite]], intending to use it to power their machine at [[Mt. Chimney]]. In [[Generation III]], after defeating the Grunts and the team's leader, the player can take the Meteorite from the machine and return it to the Professor in exchange for {{TM|27|Return}}. In [[Generation VI]], the player keeps the Meteorite for themselves after receiving it from the defeated team leader. In [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Special Demo Version]]'s first scenario, Takao appears in [[Mossdeep Space Center]], asking for {{ga|Brendan|Orlando}} and {{Steven}}'s help. In Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire proper, notes in [[Sea Mauville]] reveal that Takao's father, Raizoh, was a researcher for [[Greater Mauville Holdings]] and the [[Devon Corporation]] who spent nearly all his time working, apparently causing his marriage to unravel. One of the few things Raizoh had to remind him of his son was a Hi {{p|Skitty}} doll the latter had sent to Sea Mauville. The retrieval of that doll proves to be the object of the Sea Mauville sidequest. Takao used to live in {{ci|Rustboro}}, but at some time moved, possibly to {{to|Fallarbor}}. The letters also mention that Takao's father had once given him a {{p|Shelgon}}, but once it evolved into {{p|Salamence}}, Takao was disappointed that it no longer looked like a Meteorite and [[trade]]d it for a friend's {{p|Solrock}}. He also received a telescope from his father. In Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire's [[Delta Episode]], Professor Cozmo works at the Mossdeep Space Center to help stop the [[Grand Meteor Delta|giant meteoroid]] that's on a collision course with the planet. After noticing the meteoroid's approach at the beginning of the episode, he enlists the help of Steven Stone and the player in retrieving him [[Meteorite Shard]]s required to power the device intended to warp the meteoroid somewhere else. However, this plan is ruined when [[Zinnia]], believing the warp hole will just transport the meteoroid into {{pkmn|multiverse|another universe}} to be its problem, destroys the device, much to Cozmo's shock. Once the player has successfully destroyed the meteoroid with {{p|Rayquaza}}'s help, Cozmo is seen celebrating the good news at the Space Center. After the Delta Episode, Professor Cozmo can be found at his home in Fallarbor, where will give the player a [[Galladite]]. He also mentions that he intends to forward the new information found by the player to [[Professor Sycamore]]. Takao mentions he is friends with Sycamore, as the two worked together a few years prior to the events of the game, researching Meteorites at Meteor Falls.''"I know a man, a dear friend in the [[Kalos]] region, who has been researching [[Mega Evolution]]. We worked together a few years back here at Meteor Falls researching Meteorites. (Overworld) |} ==Quotes== {{main|Professor Cozmo/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Professor Cozmo anime.png|250px|thumb|Professor Cozmo in ''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire'']] Professor Cozmo appeared in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG054|Fight for the Meteorite!]]'', where {{Ash}} met him at Mt. Chimney. Similar to the {{pkmn|games}}, [[Team Magma]] was trying to get their hands on the Meteorite he had just found there, eventually succeeding in doing so. The Meteorite was placed inside of a machine in an attempt to make the {{cat|Volcanoes|volcano}} erupt. As Ash was unable to break the Meteorite's container, Professor Cozmo decided to push the whole machine down into the crater instead, choosing to rather lose the Meteorite than let the [[villainous team]] possess it. Afterwards, he guided Ash and {{ashfr}} to take the [[Jagged Pass]] down to [[Lavaridge Town]], wishing Ash good luck in his upcoming [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} at the [[Lavaridge Gym]]. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{rock color light}} |ja=西村朋紘 ''Tomohiro Nishimura'' |en=[[Sean Schemmel]] |fi=Ossi Valo |fr_eu=David Macaluso |it=Federico Danti |pt_br=Tatá Guarnieri |es_eu=Jesús Maniega}} ===Pokémon Generations=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Professor Cozmo PG.png|250px|thumb|Professor Cozmo in Pokémon Generations]] Professor Cozmo briefly appeared in ''[[PG09|The Scoop]]'', where he noticed [[Gabby and Ty]] infiltrating the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] in search for information regarding the destruction of the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteoroid]] that had threatened the planet. Feeling the public was not ready yet to learn of the {{p|Deoxys}} that had emerged from the destroyed meteoroid, he tried have the reporter duo hand over the information they had uncovered, only for them to run off while chased by security guards. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{rock color light}} |ja=飛田展男 ''[[Nobuo Tobita]]'' |en=Unknown |pt_br=Cláudio Galvan |es_eu=Dani Albiac}} ==In the manga== [[File:Professor Cozmo AP.png|thumb|left|180px|Professor Cozmo in Ash & Pikachu]] [[File:Professor Cozmo Adventures.png|thumb|180px|Professor Cozmo in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Ash & Pikachu=== Professor Cozmo appeared in ''[[SP23|Two Groups Attacking! Magma VS. Aqua]]'', playing a similar role as in {{aniseries|RS}}. ===Pokémon Adventures=== In the [[Chuang Yi]] translation of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}, he is referred to as '''Professor Starstone'''. This error is rectified when he appears in a flashback during the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. Cozmo is apparently good friends with [[Roxanne]] and was once her teacher. ===={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}==== Professor Cozmo believed [[Team Aqua]] to be noble heroes, so he assisted them with the [[Meteorite]] and their device on [[Mt. Chimney]]. He was taken hostage by Team Aqua and was locked inside [[Team Aqua Hideout|their headquarters]] shortly after their mission succeeded, and only rescued by [[Winona]] and [[Flannery]] deep in the weather crisis. Winona took him to the [[Pokémon Association]] airship, where he was reunited with [[Professor Cozmo's assistants|his three aides]]. ===={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}==== It was revealed in a flashback that Cozmo found the meteor that fell from the sky, which was later a part of Team Aqua's plan. He also discovered two life forms on the meteor, and passed them to [[Mossdeep Space Center]] where they were later stolen. ===={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}==== Cozmo and his three aides confirmed the imminent apocalypse of the planet in ten days by a giant meteor, and later helped out at the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] while awaiting the dimensional shifter developed by [[Devon Corporation]]. {{adv|Sapphire}}, after ending up inside the rocket on standby at the Mossdeep Space Center through one of {{p|Hoopa}}'s portals, managed to find her way out of it and handed the dimensional shifter to Cozmo, which he examined to be fully charged. He notified [[Mr. Stone]] and {{Steven}} of the successful delivery, and also the media's knowledge of the meteor's imminent collision with the planet, causing Mr. Stone and Steven to rush back to Mossdeep from [[Sea Mauville]]. ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Professor Cozmo in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Professor Cozmo|Trainer|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|EX Deoxys|Professor Cozmo's Discovery|90}}|type=Trainer|type2=Supporter|enset=EX Deoxys|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=90/107|jpset=Clash of the Blue Sky|jprarity=Uncommon|jpnum=076/082|jpset2=Deoxys Constructed Starter Deck|jpnum2=014/015|jpset3=Rayquaza Constructed Starter Deck|jpnum3=014/015|jpsetlink4=Quick Construction Packs|jpset4=Lightning Quick Construction Pack
